# Document validation materials

- text.pdf, scan.pdf, mixed.pdf, stress.pdf, page-1.png, page-2.png and rotated.png
  are generated by scripts/generate-document-fixtures.mjs. The English excerpts
  are from Joseph Jacobs's 1894 _The Fables of Aesop_ (author and translator are
  deceased more than 70 years), public domain. Source and reference text:
  https://www.gutenberg.org/files/28/28-h/28-h.htm. Lesson headings and the
  abbreviation/decimal sentences are added test material. The PDF text version
  spans a lesson across pages; the scan versions embed actual rasterized text
  without a text layer. These are controlled derived fixtures, not photographed
  paper. reference.json is the exact text used to generate the pages.
- blank.png is an empty page used for explicit failure/skip handling;
  broken.pdf is deliberately invalid plain text.
- printed-cover.jpg is the original digitized cover of the same 1894 edition:
  https://www.gutenberg.org/files/28/28-h/images/cover.jpg. Decorative cover
  typography and low contrast are evaluated separately from clean body text.
- handwriting.jpg is the original historical handwritten request for a pardon
  (Abraham Lincoln, January 27, 1864), from the public-domain _Lincoln Letters_,
  Project Gutenberg #8110: https://www.gutenberg.org/files/8110/8110-h/8110-h.htm,
  https://www.gutenberg.org/files/8110/8110-h/images/linc05.jpg. The independently
  checked first line is “Washington”. This is a real manuscript scan, not a
  generated handwriting image. Its quality check does not enable handwriting.

All samples contain public historical or generated test content; no personal
user material is used. Model and runtime licensing is recorded separately in
public/models/ppocr-tiny/NOTICE.md and the resource preparation script.
